topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I walk into the living room, the place where the party was supposed to be, and it's just empty. No balloons, no streamers hanging, no friends hiding behind the couch. I keep expecting someone to jump out, laughing, shouting the words I've been waiting for. But there's just silence. I check my phone, hoping there's some last-minute change, a new plan. The message is clear, though, the party’s off. I stand there, the invitation still crumpled in my hand, wondering what happened to all the plans.
